title: FIFA Professional Football Report 2023
scope: 2023 men’s professional football; national association coverage and definitions.
limitations: Two canonical normalized v2 datasets preserve non-null men's professional-player and professional-club counts from all 211 national pages. Missing values remain missing. Extracted national sums differ from FIFA's published global headline and are not altered. Page 38 has a KUWAIT/Kyrgyzstan identity anomaly and must not be auto-mapped.
